title: Japan earthquake relief Cherry Blossom sale
names_seen: Japan earthquake relief Cherry Blossom sale

facts.statement: Cherry Blossom items were sold via the in-game Marketplace from Friday March 25 to Monday March 28 (2011), and SOE pledged a $10 donation to the American Red Cross for each Cherry Blossom bought in that window.
facts.quote: Pour chaque 'Cherry Blossom' acheté entre le 25 au 28 mars, SOE fera un don de $10 à la Croix-Rouge américaine*.

facts.statement: SOE donated $10 to the American Red Cross for each Cherry Blossom item bought in participating games between March 25 and March 28, 2011.
facts.quote: Por cada Cherry Blossom (Cerezo de Flor) (o la opción seleccionada) adquiridos entre el 25 de marzo y 28 de marzo, SOE donará $10

article_summaries.title: Comment Aider les Victimes du Séisme au Japon!
article_summaries.summary: A French-language SOE news post (captured under the 'What is New?' page) announcing a 2011 charity sale after the Japan earthquake and tsunami. Free Realms took part by selling a 'Cherry Blossom Tree' for 500 Station Cash, with SOE donating $10 to the American Red Cross for each Cherry Blossom bought during March 25-28. The post is multi-game; the Free Realms-specific details are limited to the tree's price and availability window.

article_summaries.title: Apoyo a los Damnificados del Terremoto y Tsunami ocurrido en Japón
article_summaries.summary: This Spanish-language SOE news post (page titled 'Free Realms - What is New?') describes a March 2011 fundraiser for Japan earthquake and tsunami relief. Free Realms was one of several SOE games where a Cherry Blossom Tree could be bought for 500 Station Cash, with SOE donating $10 per Cherry Blossom purchased from March 25 to March 28 to the American Red Cross. Free Realms is only one item in a multi-game list, so the rebuild should treat it as a minor fact.
